title: West Bengal Approves ₹7 Billion Investment for 100 MW Solar Project
summary: The West Bengal Electricity Regulatory Commission (WBERC) has accorded in-principle clearance to West Bengal State Electricity Distribution Company (WBSEDCL) to incur an investment of ₹6.99 billion (~$74.89 million) to commission a 100 MW solar project with a 25 MW/100 MWh battery energy storage system. The project is to be set up at Goaltore (Phase – II) in Paschim Medinipur district.
